description: This file contains Bitbake recipe functions and Python snippets used for customizing build environment configurations in a Yocto-based build system, specifically for the RDK eSDK environment. It manages configuration files, layer inclusion, and copying of build artifacts based on machine overrides.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Writes 'meta/conf' to the templateconf.cfg file if it exists in the build directory.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes the templateconf.cfg file if certain machine overrides are present, to prevent build issues.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Adds a generic layer path to BBLAYERS if specific machine overrides are detected.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies bblayers.conf, copies kernel images, and appends build flags based on machine overrides and build environment variables.
